covers: The JSE session and the first half-hour of Wall Street trade to 16:57 SAST on Monday 9 November, against Friday 6 November closes. Prices only: news stories from today could not be opened and checked for this edition, so they are left out until they are verified.
headline: Wall Street opens higher, S&P 500 up 1.7% to 7,502, as Brent falls 4.4% to $93.96; JSE All Share up 2.1%
summary: In South Africa the JSE All Share was at 115,076.95 (+2.1% on Friday's close) and the Top 40 at 107,140.65 (+2.3%) at 16:57 SAST, with the rand firmer at R16.42/$ (-0.4%) (Yahoo Finance via LRC Market Dashboard, 9 Nov). In the US the S&P 500 was at 7,502.08 (+1.7%) and the Nasdaq at 25,121.74 (+2.2%) shortly after the 16:30 SAST open, with the 10-year Treasury yield at 4.84%, ahead of October CPI on Tuesday at 15:30 SAST (BLS schedule). Brent fell to $93.96 (-4.4%) while gold ($4,127.50, +1.3%), platinum (+1.7%) and copper (+1.8%) rose, a mix that helps miners and eases fuel-price pressure.
